payload.url: string — the character's URL on D&D Beyond (https://www.dndbeyond.com/characters/<id>, or its bare id); a URL of another host is refused
payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign the PC is imported into; required unless the command targets a PC, whose campaign it is
payload.player: uuid | null — the PC's player, of the same campaign; read only when the import creates the PC
payload.entityId: uuid — the PC the import fills, when the command's target does not name it; absent, the PC of the campaign already linked to that character is updated, else a new one created
